# Fonts for generated PDFs

The app's typefaces, embedded by `WeekPlanPdf` (Prawn can't use web fonts or
variable fonts, so these are the static TTFs).

- **Inter** 4.1 — https://github.com/rsms/inter (SIL Open Font License, see `Inter-LICENSE.txt`)
- **Instrument Serif** — https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/instrumentserif (SIL Open Font License, see `InstrumentSerif-LICENSE.txt`)
